title: Clinical Decision Framework
tabs: [{"label":"Assessment","icon":"🩺","heading":"Clinical Assessment","body":"Systematic review of presenting symptoms, vital signs, and patient history. Prioritise by acuity. Document findings using SBAR format: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. Do not proceed to diagnosis without completing assessment."},{"label":"Diagnosis","icon":"🔬","heading":"Differential Diagnosis","body":"Generate a ranked list of probable diagnoses based on assessment data. Apply Occam's razor — the simplest explanation consistent with all findings takes precedence. Document and rule out red-flag conditions first."},{"label":"Treatment","icon":"💊","heading":"Treatment Planning","body":"Select evidence-based interventions matched to confirmed diagnosis. Consider contraindications, patient preferences, and resource availability. Document decision rationale and obtain informed consent before proceeding."},{"label":"Follow-up","icon":"📋","heading":"Follow-up Protocol","body":"Define clear follow-up criteria: timeframe, responsible clinician, escalation triggers.
